description: NHFLOW hydrostatic semi-implicit on a multi-block river (3 wavy blocks in a row, 1 sigma layer, log-law bed friction): discharge G 54 1 1 through the -i face of block 1, water level G 54 2 2 at the +i face of block 2 (ioflow_amr_block).
